units.characteristics: the complaint of God's silence toward injustice
units.gist: GEM - 'O LORD, HOW LONG shall I cry for help, and you will not hear?... Why do you idly look at wrong?... justice goes forth perverted' - the honest complaint of unanswered prayer and God's apparent inaction against evil
'I am doing a work you would not believe... I am raising up the Chaldeans' - God answers the complaint with a harder problem: he will judge by a crueler nation whose 'own might is their god'

units.characteristics: the deeper problem (why use the wicked?); the resolve to wait at the watchpost
units.gist: GEM - 'you who are of PURER EYES than to see evil... why do you idly look at traitors and remain SILENT when the wicked swallows the more righteous?'; then 'I will take my stand at my WATCHPOST... to see what he will say to me' - the harder question + the waiting posture

units.characteristics: wait for the vision; the righteous shall live by his faith
units.gist: THE GEM - 'Write the vision... wait for it; it will surely come'; 'his soul is puffed up, not upright within him, BUT THE RIGHTEOUS SHALL LIVE BY HIS FAITH' - the proud/puffed-up self vs the one who lives by trusting faithfulness

units.characteristics: greed/violence and their recoil; idols vs the living God
units.gist: the five woes against the Chaldean - plunder, evil gain (nest on high, safe from harm), building a town with blood, making neighbours drunk, idols ('a teacher of lies... no breath in it'); 'the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD'; 'the LORD is in his holy temple, let all the earth keep silence'

units.characteristics: in wrath remember mercy; awe at God's coming
units.gist: 'O LORD, I have heard the report of you, and your work do I FEAR... in wrath REMEMBER MERCY'; the theophany - God comes from Teman, marches through the earth 'for the salvation of your people' - reverent awe and the plea for mercy within judgment

units.characteristics: joy in God independent of circumstance; God as strength
units.gist: THE GEM - 'I hear, and my body trembles... YET I will quietly wait'; 'THOUGH the fig tree should not blossom... the flock be cut off... YET I WILL REJOICE IN THE LORD; I will take joy in the God of my salvation. God the LORD is my STRENGTH' - joy anchored in God, not in circumstance
